DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座を開くご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Konsultasyon po sa pagbubukas ng account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい仕事の給与を受け取る口座が必要です。この銀行なら、どの店舗でもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与用口座の開設店舗に指定があるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kailangan ko ng account para sa sahod ng bagong trabaho. Kung bangkong ito, puwede ba kahit anong branch?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung may itinakdang branch sa salary account. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から、店舗の指定はありますか。案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May itinakda ba ang kumpanya? Dala ninyo ang gabay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には銀行名だけだと思っていましたが、小さい字で営業部名も書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先案内の営業部名に気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko pangalan lang ng bangko, pero may pangalan din ng business department sa maliit na letra.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing napansin ang business department sa gabay ng kumpanya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それが勤務先の指定か、振込みを扱う部署名か、勤務先へ確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakitiyak sa kumpanya kung iyon ang branch na itinakda o departamento ng transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人事担当へメッセージを送ります。口座番号を提出する期限は来週月曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先へ照会し口座番号の提出期限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Magmemensahe ako sa personnel. Sa susunod na Lunes ang huling araw ng pagpasa ng account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magtanong sa kumpanya at ibigay ang deadline ng account number. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期限もお知らせください。こちらでは開設に必要な資料の案内をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sabihin din ang deadline. Maibibigay namin ang gabay sa kailangang dokumento.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資料の案内をください。今日は契約書と本人確認の物を持っていますが、店舗が決まってから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要資料の案内を求め店舗確定後に申込むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pahingi. Dala ko ngayon ang kontrata at ID, pero mag-a-apply kapag tiyak na ang branch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng gabay sa dokumento at sabihing mag-a-apply kapag tiyak ang branch. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料はこの一覧でご確認ください。開設の可否や時期は受付後の確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Tingnan ang listahang ito. Kung mabubuksan at kailan ay susuriin matapos tanggapin ang aplikasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一覧を受け取りました。勤務先の返事を見て、指定がなければここで相談を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一覧を受け取り勤務先回答に応じて相談を再開すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natanggap ko ang listahan. Titingnan ang sagot ng kumpanya at kung walang itinakda, itutuloy ko rito ang konsultasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tanggapin ang listahan at ipagpatuloy ayon sa sagot ng kumpanya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしています。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hihintayin namin kayo. Salamat sa pagkonsulta. Paalam po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札で、分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May hindi po ba malinaw sa price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この梨は二百円ですか。隣の袋も同じ棚にあるので、袋全体の値段か迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ棚のばら梨と袋の値札の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: 200 yen ba ang peras? Nasa parehong estante ang katabing supot, kaya nalito kung presyo ng buong supot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang ugnayan ng tag sa tinging peras at supot sa parehong estante. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二百円はばら売り一個の値段です。三個入りの袋は、袋の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: 200 yen ang isang tingi. Para sa supot na tatlo, tingnan ang label sa supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋には五百四十円とありますね。ばらで三個なら六百円なので、袋の方が安いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三個の合計価格を比べ袋売りが安いか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: 540 yen ang supot. Kung tatlong tingi 600, kaya mas mura ang supot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihambing ang kabuuan ng tatlo at itanong kung mas mura ang supot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表示ではそうなります。ただ、袋の梨は少し小さめです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ayon sa label, oo. Pero mas maliit nang kaunti ang nasa supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は二人で一個を分けたいので、大きいばらの物を一個選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用途を理由に大きいばら梨を一個選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dalawa kaming maghahati sa isa ngayon, kaya isang malaking tingi ang pipiliin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pumili ng isang malaking tingi ayon sa gamit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。重さで量る品ではなく、一個ずつお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Hindi ito tinitimbang; binabayaran bawat piraso.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一個ですね。袋から取り出して買うのではなく、このばらの棚から選べばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ばら品を選ぶ棚と袋を開けないことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Isa, tama? Dito sa tinging estante pipili, hindi kukuha mula sa supot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang estante ng tingi at hindi pagbukas ng supot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。三個入りの袋は開けず、こちらの棚からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Huwag buksan ang supot na tatlo; dito pumili.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この大きい梨を選びました。袋の方と混ざらないよう、レジで一個と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一個を選びレジで数量を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itong malaki ang pinili ko. Sasabihin kong isa sa kahera para hindi malito sa supot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pumili ng isa at sabihing ibibigay ang dami sa kahera. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。おいしく召し上がれますように。失礼します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内図で道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Naghahanap po ng daan sa mapa ng parke?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池まで少し歩きたいです。図では右なのに、目の前には左へ曲がる道しか見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図の左右と見える道が合わないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong lumakad nang kaunti sa lawa. Kanan sa mapa, pero pakaliwang daan lang ang nakikita sa harap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi tugma ang kaliwa-kanan ng mapa at nakikitang daan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の上が北です。今は南向きに立っているので、左右が逆に見えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hilaga ang itaas ng mapa. Nakatimog kayo ngayon kaya baligtad ang kaliwa-kanan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の向きと図の向きが違うのですね。図を回して、今見ている景色と合わせてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図と自分の向きの違いを理解し地図を回せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iba ang harap ko at mapa. Puwedeng ikutin para tumugma sa tanawin ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawain ang pagkakaiba ng direksiyon at itanong ang pag-ikot ng mapa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。入口の印を手前にすると、目の前の道と合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Ilapit ang marka ng pasukan sa inyo para tumugma sa harap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回したら左の道が池へ続いていました。図にある丸い建物は、あの売店ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図を回して道を読み建物の印を実物と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pagkaikot, ang kaliwa ay patungo sa lawa. Ang bilog na gusali sa mapa ba ay ang tindahang iyon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ikutin, basahin ang daan, at itugma ang simbolo ng gusali sa aktuwal. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。売店は左の道の途中です。池はその先にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tama. Nasa kaliwang daan ang tindahan, lampas doon ang lawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 売店を通り過ぎればよいですね。帰りは図を元に戻さず、自分の向きに合わせ直せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往路の目印を確認し帰りの地図の向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Lalampasan ang tindahan, tama? Sa balik, itutugma muli sa harap ko sa halip na ibalik sa orihinal ang mapa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang palatandaan sa papunta at itanong ang direksiyon sa pabalik. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時は向きが変わるので、入口と売店の位置を景色と合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Magbabago ang harap sa balik, kaya itapat ang pasukan at tindahan sa tanawin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの建物を目印にします。池まで歩いて、帰りにも向きを合わせて入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物で地図と景色を照らし池まで往復すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Dalawang gusali ang palatandaan. Lalakad sa lawa at itutugma muli sa pagbalik sa pasukan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gamitin ang gusali sa mapa at tanawin at planuhin ang balikan sa lawa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり。お散歩をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 工事中の通路についてご案内します。どちらへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ipapaliwanag ko ang daang ginagawa. Saan po kayo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 南線へ乗り換えます。いつも使う階段が囲われていますが、今日は通れませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通常の乗換階段が使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Lilipat sa South Line. Nabakuran ang karaniwang hagdan; bawal ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung magagamit ang karaniwang hagdan sa transfer. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は使えません。奥の仮通路から、別の階段へ回ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi ngayon. Dumaan sa pansamantalang daan sa loob papunta sa ibang hagdan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の仮通路ですね。いつもより何分くらい余計に見ておけばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仮通路の余分な移動時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pansamantalang daan sa loob. Ilang dagdag na minuto ang ilalaan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang dagdag na oras ng pansamantalang daan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩いて三分ほど増えます。乗り換える列車は、何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Mga tatlong minuto pang lakad. Anong oras ang lilipatang tren?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 九時二十分です。今からだと急いで階段を使うことになりそうです。次の列車もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定列車では急ぐことになると説明し次便を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: 9:20. Mula ngayon mukhang magmamadali ako sa hagdan. May kasunod na tren?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing kailangang magmadali para sa plano at itanong ang susunod. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次は九時三十五分です。仮通路は幅が狭いので、走らずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: 9:35 ang susunod. Makipot ang daan; huwag tumakbo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三十五分の列車にします。仮通路の出口で、南線のどちらのホームへ出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便へ変更し仮通路出口のホーム案内を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: 9:35 na lang. Saang peron ng South Line lalabas ang pansamantalang daan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Piliin ang susunod at itanong ang peron sa labasan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方向への案内がある広場へ出ます。南町方面は二番ホームの表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa bukas na lugar na may gabay sa dalawang direksiyon. Para Minamimachi, Peron 2.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広場で二番ホームを探します。次の列車にしたので、急がず回れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場で目的方面のホームを探して移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hahanapin ang Peron 2 doon. Susunod na ang pinili kaya makalilibot nang hindi nagmamadali.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hahanapin ang tamang peron sa bukas na lugar at tutuloy. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。お気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Salamat sa pakikiisa. Mag-ingat sa biyahe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二か所へ出すので二通欲しいのですが、一方は「写し可」とあります。二通取らなくてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原本と写しで二通の発行が必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa dalawang lugar ipapasa kaya gusto ko ng dalawa, pero ang isa ay puwedeng kopya. Hindi na kailangan magpagawa ng dalawa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung dalawang terbit ang kailangan kung may orihinal at kopya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の指定が「写し可」なら、何を写すのかも案内で確認しましょう。お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kung puwedeng kopya, tiyakin din sa gabay kung ano ang kokopyahin. Dala ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。原本一通を先の学校へ出して、もう一方にはそのコピーを出せると書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先案内の原本一通とコピーの指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Heto. Isang orihinal sa unang paaralan at photocopy nito sa isa pa ang nakasulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang gabay ng isang orihinal at photocopy. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内では、そのように読めます。コピーは原本を提出する前に用意できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ganoon ang basa sa gabay. Makakakopya bago ipasa ang orihinal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先にコピーを取ります。今日は原本を一通だけ申請したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本を提出前にコピーし一通だけ申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kokopyahin muna. Ngayon isang orihinal lang ang aaplayan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kopyahin bago ipasa at humiling ng isang orihinal. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一通で承ります。コピーに追加の記入が必要かは、もう一方の提出先へお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Isa ang tatanggapin. Kung may dagdag na sulat sa kopya, tiyakin sa kabilang tatanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その案内には、自分の受付番号を余白に書くとあります。原本には書かず、コピーへ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本とコピーへの追加記入の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sulat daw ang reception number sa margin. Hindi sa orihinal kundi sa kopya ko isusulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang magkaibang dagdag na sulat sa orihinal at kopya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの扱いを分けられましたね。こちらへ必要な証明書の種類をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naibukod na. Isulat dito ang uri ng sertipiko.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 種類と一通と書きました。原本を受け取ったら、学校へ出す前にコピーします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申請通数を記入し提出前のコピー予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Uri at isa na ang naisulat. Pagkatanggap ng orihinal, kokopyahin bago sa paaralan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Isulat ang dami at sabihin ang pagkopya bago ipasa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請書をお預かりします。窓口へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatanggapin ang form. Sa counter po. Paalam.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の睡眠の欄で、お尋ねがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May tanong sa tulog na bahagi ng medical form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤があります。「寝る時刻」は、夜勤明けに寝る昼の時刻を書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤明けに昼に寝る時刻を問診へ書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May night shift ako. Puwedeng oras ng tulog sa araw pagkagaling sa night shift ang bedtime?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang daytime sleep pagkatapos ng night shift sa form. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。勤務の日と休みの日で違うことも、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Opo. Sabihin ding magkaiba sa araw ng trabaho at pahinga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜勤明けは朝九時に寝ます。休みの日は夜十一時なので、一つの時刻だけでは合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夜勤明けと休日の就寝時刻を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Alas-nuwebe ng umaga pagkatapos ng shift. Sa pahinga alas-onse ng gabi kaya hindi tugma ang iisang oras.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang bedtime pagkagaling night shift at sa pahinga. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの時刻を分けて書けます。起きる時刻も、それぞれ伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Puwedeng dalawang oras magkahiwalay. Itatanong din ang paggising ng bawat isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜勤明けは午後三時、休みの日は朝七時です。夜勤の前には一時間ほど仮眠も取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: それぞれの起床時刻と勤務前の仮眠を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Alas-tres ng hapon pagkatapos ng shift at alas-siyete ng umaga sa pahinga. Umiidlip din isang oras bago mag-night shift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang bawat oras ng gising at idlip bago trabaho. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仮眠のことも、余白へお書きください。眠りについて、今困っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Isulat din ang idlip sa margin. May problema sa tulog ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休みの日も明け方に目が覚めます。でも、夜勤明けの昼は続けて眠れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休日の早い目覚めと昼の睡眠の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kahit sa pahinga nagigising ako sa madaling-araw. Pero dire-diretso sa araw pagkagaling shift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang maagang gising sa pahinga at tuloy-tuloy na tulog sa araw. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕事のない日の目覚めの様子を、診察でもお話しください。夜勤は週に何回でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabihin din sa doktor ang paggising sa araw na walang trabaho. Ilang night shift kada linggo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 週二回です。二つの睡眠時間と仮眠を書き、休日の明け方に目が覚めることを先生へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夜勤の頻度と睡眠と仮眠を記入し困る点を診察で話すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Dalawa. Isusulat ang dalawang tulog at idlip, at sasabihing nagigising madaling-araw sa pahinga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang dalas, isulat ang tulog at idlip, at sabihin ang problema sa konsultasyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診票を確認しました。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Natingnan ko ang form. Ingatan ang kalusugan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 訪問した人についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa bumisita ang konsultasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に来た人が警察だと言って、口座の確認を求めました。制服ではなく、名前も聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 警察を名乗る訪問者の口座確認要求を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: May dumating na nagsabing pulis at humiling tingnan ang account. Walang uniporme, at hindi ko narinig nang malinaw ang pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang bisitang nagsasabing pulis at humihiling ng account check. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何時ごろでしたか。相手は今も家にいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Anong oras? Nasa bahay pa ba?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一時間前で、もう帰りました。夕方また来ると言われ、名刺だけ置いていきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問時刻と退去済みと再訪予告を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Isang oras na, umalis na. Babalik daw mamayang hapon at business card lang ang iniwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang oras, pag-alis, at planong pagbabalik. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名刺を拝見します。口座について、何か渡したり見せたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan ko ang card. May ibinigay o ipinakitang tungkol sa account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何も見せていません。家の中にも入っていません。名刺にある番号にも電話していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 情報や入室の許可をしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Walang ipinakita. Hindi rin pumasok sa bahay. Hindi ko tinawagan ang nasa card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na walang impormasyon o pahintulot pumasok. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで訪問の事実を確認します。夕方に来ても、確認が済むまでドアを開けて対応しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan namin ang pagbisita. Kahit dumating mamaya, huwag buksan ang pinto hangga't hindi natitiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。玄関の録画には顔と時刻が残っています。映像も見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訪問確認を頼み録画の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuri. Nasa recording ng pasukan ang mukha at oras. Puwedeng tingnan din?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang pagbisita at recording. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残っている映像の扱いをご案内します。今お持ちの端末で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang paghawak sa natirang video. Makikita ba sa dala ninyong device?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この携帯で見られます。名刺と映像をお見せして、再訪の前に相談を進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名刺と録画を示し再訪前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa teleponong ito. Gusto kong ipakita ang card at video at kumonsulta bago siya bumalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang card at video at gustong kumonsulta bago balik. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの相談席で伺います。お知らせありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito sa konsultasyon kami makikinig. Salamat sa pag-abiso. Paalam.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の送り先は、こちらの宿泊施設ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Itong tutuluyan ang padadalhan ng pakete, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。週末に泊まる宿へ送ります。送り状は宿の名前だけ書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿泊先への送り状の宛名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, sa tutuluyan ngayong weekend. Pangalan lang ba ng lugar ang nasa shipping label?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang addressee sa label patungo sa tutuluyan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿が指定する宛名があれば、それに合わせてください。荷物の受け取りについて、宿へ連絡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kung may itinakda ang lugar, sundin iyon. Nakausap na tungkol sa pagtanggap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受け取れると返事をもらいました。宿泊する人の名前と到着予定日を書くよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿への受取確認と氏名と到着日の指定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sumagot na puwedeng tumanggap. Pangalan ng bisita at inaasahang dating daw ang isulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nakumpirma ang pagtanggap at ang kailangan na pangalan at petsa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つが宿での確認に役立ちます。到着予定日はどちらへ書きましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Nakatutulong ang dalawa sa pagtukoy. Saan isusulat ang dating?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛名の横の余白に、土曜日の日付と自分の名前を書きます。宿の住所はこのメールにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名へ追記する日付と氏名と住所資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa margin katabi ng addressee, petsa ng Sabado at pangalan ko. Nasa email ang address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang dagdag na petsa at pangalan at pinagkunan ng address. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メールの住所と送り状を照らし合わせてください。配達希望日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ihambing ang address sa email at label. May nais na araw ng delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宿から前日の金曜日を指定されました。間に合わない場合は、自分で持っていきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿指定の配達希望日と未達の場合の持参代案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itinakda nilang Biyernes bago nito. Kung hindi aabot, ako na ang magdadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang itinakdang delivery at alternatibong pagdala kung hindi aabot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この住所へのお届け予定を受付で確認します。希望日を保証する前に、発送条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titingnan ng reception ang dating sa address. Ipapaliwanag ang kondisyon bago garantiyahan ang araw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。宛名は書けましたが、予定を聞いてから発送するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を用意し配送予定を聞いて発送判断すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakisuyo. Naisulat ang addressee pero magpapasya pagkadinig ng iskedyul.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihanda ang addressee at magpasya sa pagpapadala matapos ang iskedyul. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、荷物と送り状を受付へどうぞ。ご準備ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Pakidala ang pakete at label sa reception. Salamat sa paghahanda.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの準備で、お尋ねがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May tanong habang naghahanda ng transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込みます。五万円と書いたのですが、通知には管理費三千円も載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃額に別記の管理費が必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Renta ang ipapadala. 50,000 yen ang isinulat, pero may 3,000 management fee rin sa abiso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung idaragdag ang management fee na hiwalay sa renta. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理費も同じ振込みに含める指定でしょうか。通知を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kasama ba sa parehong transfer ang fee ayon sa abiso? Tingnan ko.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下に「合計五万三千円」とありました。去年の家賃だけを覚えていて、少なく書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知の合計と誤記した金額の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Total 53,000 ang nasa ibaba. Renta lang noong nakaraang taon ang natandaan kaya kulang ang sulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang iba sa total ng abiso at maling halaga. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込額は今回の通知を基にご確認ください。まだ受付はしていませんので、依頼書を直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Batay sa abisong ito tiyakin ang halaga. Hindi pa natatanggap kaya puwedeng itama.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五万三千円に直します。数字の途中を直すより、新しい用紙に書き直した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい合計に直す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gagawing 53,000. Mas mabuti bang bagong papel kaysa baguhin sa gitna ng numero?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paraan sa pagtama ng total. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直す用紙はこちらです。古い用紙もこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Narito ang bagong form. Ibigay rin ang luma.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い方を渡して、新しい方へ全額を書きました。今月から管理費が増えたことも通知にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧用紙を渡し新用紙に全額を書き管理費変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ibinigay ang luma at buong halaga sa bago. May pagtaas din ng management fee simula ngayong buwan sa abiso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang luma, isulat nang buo sa bago, at sabihin ang pagbabago ng fee. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込先と金額を、新しい依頼書で見直してください。自動の振込み設定は使っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Balikan ang padadalhan at halaga sa bago. May automatic transfer setting ba?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 設定は使っていません。来月も古い金額を写さず通知を見ます。今日は五万三千円をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自動設定がないと答え今回の合計で振込みを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Wala. Sa susunod tingnan ang abiso, hindi kokopya ng luma. 53,000 ngayong araw, pakiusap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang automatic setting at humiling ng kasalukuyang total. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい依頼書で承ります。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sa bagong form ipoproseso. Salamat sa pagtiyak. Paalam.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでお会計します。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Dito ko po bibilangin. May bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋を一つ持っています。水を二本入れると、卵が入らなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋が小さく水と卵が収まるか心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isang maliit. Kung dalawang tubig, parang hindi kasya ang itlog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing maliit ang bag at nangangambang hindi kasya ang tubig at itlog. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋を追加でお買い求めいただけます。別々に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Puwedeng bumili ng isa pa. Ihihiwalay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は歩いて帰るので、荷物を減らします。水を一本だけにしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩いて帰るため水を一本に減らしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lalakad pauwi ngayon kaya babawasan ang dala. Isang bote na lang ba puwede?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Bawasan sa isang tubig dahil lalakad pauwi. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ会計前ですので、一本をこちらでお戻しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi pa bayad, kami ang magbabalik ng isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。水は袋の底へ、卵は上へ置きたいです。袋に収まりそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品を入れる順序と袋への収まりを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat. Tubig sa ilalim at itlog sa ibabaw sana. Mukhang kasya ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagkakasunod sa paglagay at kasya sa bag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの台で大きさを見られます。卵の箱を横へ立てずに入るかお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Dito sa mesa masusukat. Subukang ilagay nang patag ang karton, hindi patagilid na nakatayo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平らに置いて収まりました。追加の袋は要りません。この袋へ詰めるのは会計後ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵を平らに置けたと伝え袋不要と詰める時期を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kasya nang patag. Hindi kailangan dagdag na bag. Pagbayad ko pa ito iimpake, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing kasya patag, walang dagdag na bag, at tiyakin ang oras ng pag-impake. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今は商品をかごに戻して、お会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Ibalik muna sa basket at magbayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水一本と卵一箱でお願いします。会計後に底と上を分けて入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計数量と袋への入れ方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Isang tubig at isang karton ng itlog. Pagbayad ilalagay nang hiwalay ilalim at ibabaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang dami sa bayaran at paglalagay sa bag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お買物ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
